name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A well-known TypeScript educator's personal collection of instruction files that make AI coding assistants behave more like a disciplined senior engineer, free to copy into your own projects.
buyer: An individual developer or small team that wants their AI coding assistant to follow better engineering habits without building those rules from scratch.
business_use_cases: A solo developer adopts these skills wholesale to raise the quality bar of their AI-assisted code without hiring a reviewer.
A content creator builds a paid newsletter or course teaching developers how to adapt and extend personal skill libraries like this one for their own stack.
A dev-tooling company studies widely-starred skill repos like this to shape what features their own paid 'AI engineering assistant' product should ship with.

money_ideas.idea: Paid course or newsletter teaching developers to build and maintain their own skill library
Sponsorships/affiliate revenue from the creator's existing audience around this and related free repos

steal_this: This is mainly a personal brand/content asset for its author rather than a product to resell — the honest opportunity for anyone else is studying it as a template, not monetizing the repo itself.
